title: Tester acceptance probability formula
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $\ell:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ and $q:\mathbb F_2^{n\times n}\to\mathbb F_2$. The acceptance probability of the four-query tester for the oracle that equals $\ell$ on vectors and $q$ on matrices is the uniform average over independent uniform $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and $z\in\mathbb F_2^{n^2}$ of the indicator that $\ell(x)\ell(y)=q(Z)+q(Z+xy^{\mathsf T})$, where $Z$ is the matrix obtained by reshaping $z$ into an $n\times n$ matrix.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a function from binary vectors of length $n$ to $\mathbb F_2$
$q$ is a function from binary $n\times n$ matrices to $\mathbb F_2$
